risks.risk: Exact model mismatch (DGX 520 vs another Yamaha DGX/PSR model) which changes value and parts compatibility.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model name/number label (usually on the back panel or underside) and the front panel model text.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Yamaha portable keyboard (worst-case: not confirmed DGX 520).

risks.risk: Not tested / may have non-working functions (sound, speakers, keys, pedals, power adapter).
risks.proof: A short video showing power-on, playing several keys, volume control, and at least one demo sound; include pedal test if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully guaranteed working (worst-case: needs testing/possible faults).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power adapter, sustain pedal, stand, music rest) affecting usability and resale.
risks.proof: A photo laid out showing all included items: power adapter, sustain pedal, stand, manuals, and any cables.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming key accessories may be missing (worst-case: buyer must source them).

risks.risk: Physical wear/damage not fully visible (key wobble, stuck keys, cracked casing, speaker distortion).
risks.proof: Close-ups of the keybed (especially around the middle and ends) plus corners/ports; include a video playing across the full keyboard range.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming average wear and possible minor issues not visible in the single photo.

Video: power-on + playing across the keyboard + volume + one feature (e.g., demo/voice) with audio.
Photos of included accessories (power adapter, sustain pedal, stand/music rest/manuals).
Close-ups of keys and ports (headphone, USB/MIDI if present) and corners.
